relationships.subject: LASSBio-2265
relationships.evidence_quote: The obtained data confirmed that LASSBio-2265 (11) is a partial inverse agonist of human CB2 receptors, with an EC50 of 0.369 ± 0.03 μM and an efficacy of 63% of the maximum effect.

relationships.subject: LASSBio-2265
relationships.evidence_quote: The results indicated that 11 shows a moderate affinity for CB2 receptors, with Ki = 16.0 ± 3 µM.

relationships.subject: LASSBio-2265
relationships.evidence_quote: during the second phase, LASSBio-2265 (11) proved to be comparable to both morphine and ASA, with dose-dependent progressive effect

key_findings: NSAID-pyrazolamide LASSBio-2265 is a partial CB2 inverse agonist (EC50 0.36 uM, Ki 16 uM) with no effect on CB1
LASSBio-2265 reduced late-phase formalin nociception in mice, comparable to morphine and ASA
